description: Set the VPS hostname (valid DNS name). Applied immediately inside the running server via the guest agent (Linux: hostnamectl + the 127.0.1.1 line in /etc/hosts; Windows: renamed, takes effect after a reboot — the response then has `reboot_required: true`). The server must be running with its guest agent active; otherwise the call fails with 409 `agent_unavailable` and nothing is changed. Your password, SSH host keys and files are not touched. Requires: token, server running. Typical error: 409 agent_unavailable → start the server / wait for boot.

service_id.description: Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

name: set_hostname
title: Set hostname
